name: WCC Western PBQ Championship - Santa Clara 2026

venue.name: Santa Clara University
venue.address: 500 El Camino Real Santa Clara, CA 95053
venue.details: Sobrato Campus for Discovery and Innovation (SCDI Building, 3rd Floor, Rooms 3301 & 3302).

information:
### For the first time the Western Championship PBQ will be held at multiple locations on the same day! Please read the "[Westerns PBQ FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsPBQChampionshipSanta2026#71056-western-pbq-championship-faq)" for more information.

### This is the competition site for the SANTA CLARA Location. You can find the other [locations here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsPBQChampionshipSanta2026#71055-western-pbq-locations). Competitors at the SCU location will be required to fill out and submit [SCU's liability form](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aN52eBqg3IX2KroaLRDrzmlDiXyRp0Yg/view?usp=sharing) prior to competing. This will be collected at a later time.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NjQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cf643f8826077f011ac9001e0e28d1f7cb4b8b45/WesternsLogo%20-%20Edited.png)

- Current SCU students are eligible for a 66% discount. They must pay the full $18 fee in order to register for the competition but will be refunded 66% after they attend the competition. Professor Marks (rmarks@scu.edu) will verify SCU student status upon receiving an email from the competitor's @scu.edu account.
